<reason>CON won a competitive debate by making the live comparison cleaner: a requirement binds on residual nights after food is no longer sellable, so the certain extra job (classify, hold, document, wait) is not a free meal. PRO’s France-intake and “same fridge/same software” claims were overclaimed and then forced into a documented-attempt retreat, while CON refused the waste-shrinkage trap and kept the proposition as a ban on the last operational choice rather than a plan that already pays.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s R2 after Q1: same tracking is not the donation job, intake is not dinner, and a documented attempt plus dumpster is a form, not a table, on the nights the mandate actually binds.</best_rebuttal>
